nodes.label: sign_in
nodes.summary: Authenticate native credentials; never collect passwords or session tokens.

nodes.label: upload_file
nodes.summary: A signed-in member creates a file for administrator review.

nodes.label: pending_review
nodes.summary: The uploader and administrator retain file access.

nodes.label: review_file
nodes.summary: Choose approval or rejection; the decision waits for notification delivery.

nodes.label: review_notice_wait
nodes.summary: The selected decision has not taken effect.

nodes.label: deliver_review_notice
nodes.summary: Write the uploader notification and apply the review decision in one transaction.

nodes.label: approved_file
nodes.summary: Only an effective approval allows the uploader to share.

nodes.label: rejected_file
nodes.summary: The file cannot be shared; the uploader and administrator retain access.

nodes.label: share_file
nodes.summary: Create a sharing request for a designated colleague.

nodes.label: share_notice_wait
nodes.summary: The designated recipient has no access from this request yet.

nodes.label: deliver_share_notice
nodes.summary: Write the recipient notification and activate the grant in one transaction.

nodes.label: active_share
nodes.summary: The effective grant applies to the designated recipient.

nodes.label: view_file
nodes.summary: File access is allowed for the uploader, administrator or an active designated recipient.

nodes.label: download_file
nodes.summary: Use the same access condition as file viewing.

nodes.label: message_list
nodes.summary: The uploader sees review results; the designated recipient sees share messages.

nodes.label: revoke_share
nodes.summary: The uploader withdraws a pending or active recipient grant in the native transaction.

nodes.label: revoked_share
nodes.summary: The recipient grant is ineffective immediately; late original notification jobs cannot activate it.

nodes.label: deliver_revoke_notice
nodes.summary: Deliver the revocation message to the original recipient; notice failure never restores the grant.

def sign_in(self, username, password):
        with self.bo.span("sign_in",lambda:{"inputs":{"username":username,"credential_supplied":bool(password)}},provenance=self.bo.bo_authentication_provenance()) as call:
            rows=self.store.read("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username=?",(username,))
            if not rows or not check_password_hash(rows[0]["password_hash"],password):
                raise DomainError("invalid_credentials",401)
            user=self.principal(rows[0]["id"])
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"user_id":user["id"],"authenticated":True},"provenance":{"actor":{"id":user["id"],"kind":"user"}}})
            return user

upload_file.snippet:
def upload_file(self, actor, filename, content):
        self.require_user(actor)
        filename=PurePath(filename.replace("\\","/")).name.strip()
        if not filename or len(filename)>200 or len(content)>10*1024*1024:
            raise DomainError("invalid_file",400)
        with self.bo.span("upload_file",lambda:{"inputs":{"filename":filename,"size":len(content)}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor)) as call:
            self.check("upload",actor)
            identity="file-"+uuid.uuid4().hex
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                connection.execute("INSERT INTO files(id,owner_id,filename,size,content,state,workflow_id,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                    (identity,actor["id"],filename,len(content),content,"pending_review","workflow-"+uuid.uuid4().hex,time.time()))
            file=self.get_file(identity)
            result=lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":identity,"state":file["state"]},"provenance":self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"File","id":identity,"role":"output"}])}
            call.record("commit",result)
            call.result(result)
            self.bo.state(file)
            return self.metadata(file)

guards.expression: not filename or len(filename) > 200 or len(content) > 10 * 1024 * 1024

review_file.snippet:
def review_file(self, actor, file_id, decision, reason):
        self.require_user(actor)
        file=self.get_file(file_id)
        with self.bo.span("review_file",lambda:{"inputs":{"file_id":file_id,"decision":decision,"reason":reason}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file)) as call:
            if decision not in ("approved","rejected") or (decision=="rejected" and not reason.strip()) or len(reason)>1000:
                raise DomainError("invalid_review",400)
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                file=self.get_file(file_id,connection)
                self.check("review",actor,file,connection)
                if file["state"]!="pending_review":
                    raise DomainError("review_already_decided",409)
                state=self.workflow.transition(connection,file_id,file["state"],"review",file["revision"]+1,time.time())
                connection.execute("UPDATE files SET state=?,review_decision=?,rejection_reason=?,reviewer_id=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=?",
                    (state,decision,reason.strip() if decision=="rejected" else "",actor["id"],file_id))
                job_id=self.enqueue(connection,"review",file,None,file["owner_id"])
            file=self.get_file(file_id)
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":file_id,"job_id":job_id,"state":file["state"],"decision":decision},
                "provenance":self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"Job","id":job_id,"role":"output"}])})
            self.bo.state(file)
            return self.metadata(file)

guards.expression: decision not in ('approved', 'rejected') or (decision == 'rejected' and (not reason.strip())) or len(reason) > 1000

deliver_review_notice.snippet:
def deliver_notification(self, job_id, fail_after_message=False):
        jobs=self.store.read("SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE id=?",(job_id,))
        if not jobs or jobs[0]["state"]!="waiting":
            return False
        job=jobs[0]
        with self.bo.bo_receive_metadata(job["bo_carrier"]):
            node={"review":"deliver_review_notice","share":"deliver_share_notice","revoke":"deliver_revoke_notice"}[job["kind"]]
            provenance=self.bo.bo_worker_provenance(job)
            with self.bo.span(node,lambda:{"inputs":{"job_id":job_id,"file_id":job["file_id"],"fail_after_message":fail_after_message}},provenance=provenance) as call:
                file=self.get_file(job["file_id"])
                try:
                    with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                        current=connection.execute("SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE id=?",(job_id,)).fetchone()
                        if current["state"]!="waiting":
                            native_state="already_delivered" if current["state"]=="delivered" else current["state"]
                            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"delivered":False,"state":native_state,"job_id":job_id}})
                            return False
                        message_id="message-"+uuid.uuid4().hex
                        file=self.get_file(file["id"],connection)
                        if job["kind"]=="share":
                            share=dict(connection.execute("SELECT * FROM shares WHERE id=?",(job["share_id"],)).fetchone())
                            if share["state"]!="share_notice_wait":
                                connection.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state='cancelled' WHERE id=?",(job_id,))
                                call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"delivered":False,"state":share["state"],"job_id":job_id}})
                                return False
                        text=("Review "+file["review_decision"]+": "+file["filename"]+(" — "+file["rejection_reason"] if file["rejection_reason"] else "")) if job["kind"]=="review" else (("Sharing was revoked: " if job["kind"]=="revoke" else "A file was shared with you: ")+file["filename"])
                        connection.execute("INSERT INTO messages VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",(message_id,job["recipient_id"],job_id,file["id"],job["kind"],text,time.time()))
                        if fail_after_message:
                            raise RuntimeError("injected_delivery_failure")
                        if job["kind"]=="review":
                            entity_id=file["id"]
                            state=self.workflow.transition(connection,entity_id,file["state"],file["review_decision"],file["revision"]+1,time.time())
                            connection.execute("UPDATE files SET state=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=?",(state,entity_id))
                        elif job["kind"]=="share":
                            entity_id=share["id"]
                            state=self.workflow.transition(connection,entity_id,share["state"],"deliver",share["revision"]+1,time.time())
                            connection.execute("UPDATE shares SET state=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=?",(state,entity_id))
                        else:
                            share=dict(connection.execute("SELECT * FROM shares WHERE id=?",(job["share_id"],)).fetchone())
                            entity_id,state=share["id"],share["state"]
                        connection.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state='delivered',delivered_at=?,attempts=attempts+1,last_error='' WHERE id=?",(time.time(),job_id))
                    result={"delivered":True,"state":state,"job_id":job_id,"message_id":message_id,"file_id":file["id"]}
                    completed=self.bo.bo_completed_provenance(provenance,message_id)
                    call.record("commit",lambda:{"outputs":result,"provenance":completed})
                    call.result(lambda:{"outputs":result,"provenance":completed})
                    table="files" if job["kind"]=="review" else "shares"
                    if job["kind"]!="revoke":
                        self.bo.state({"id":entity_id,"state":state,"revision":self.store.read("SELECT revision FROM "+table+" WHERE id=?",(entity_id,))[0]["revision"]})
                    return True
                except Exception as error:
                    with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                        connection.execute("UPDATE jobs SET attempts=attempts+1,last_error=?,available_at=? WHERE id=? AND state='waiting'",(type(error).__name__,time.time()+self.delay,job_id))
                    raise

def share_file(self, actor, file_id, recipient_id):
        self.require_user(actor)
        file=self.get_file(file_id)
        with self.bo.span("share_file",lambda:{"inputs":{"file_id":file_id,"recipient_id":recipient_id}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"User","id":recipient_id,"role":"recipient"}])) as call:
            if recipient_id==actor["id"] or self.principal(recipient_id) is None:
                raise DomainError("invalid_recipient",400)
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                file=self.get_file(file_id,connection)
                self.check("share",actor,file,connection)
                if connection.execute("SELECT 1 FROM shares WHERE file_id=? AND recipient_id=?",(file_id,recipient_id)).fetchone():
                    raise DomainError("share_already_exists",409)
                share_id="share-"+uuid.uuid4().hex
                state=self.workflow.transition(connection,share_id,"approved","share",1,time.time())
                connection.execute("INSERT INTO shares(id,file_id,recipient_id,sender_id,state,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                    (share_id,file_id,recipient_id,actor["id"],state,time.time()))
                job_id=self.enqueue(connection,"share",file,share_id,recipient_id)
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":file_id,"share_id":share_id,"job_id":job_id,"state":state},
                "provenance":self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"Share","id":share_id,"role":"output"},{"type":"Job","id":job_id,"role":"output"},{"type":"User","id":recipient_id,"role":"recipient"}])})
            self.bo.state({"id":share_id,"state":state,"revision":1})
            return {"id":share_id,"state":state,"recipient_id":recipient_id}

class TeamFiles:
    def __init__(self, store, workflow, bo=None, delay=5.0):
        self.store,self.workflow=store,workflow
        self.bo,self.delay=bo or ObservationPort(),delay
    def principal(self, user_id):
        rows=self.store.read("SELECT id,username,display_name,role FROM users WHERE id=?",(user_id,)) if user_id else []
        return rows[0] if rows else None
    def require_user(self, actor):
        if actor is None:
            raise DomainError("authentication_required",401)
        return actor
    def sign_in(self, username, password):
        with self.bo.span("sign_in",lambda:{"inputs":{"username":username,"credential_supplied":bool(password)}},provenance=self.bo.bo_authentication_provenance()) as call:
            rows=self.store.read("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username=?",(username,))
            if not rows or not check_password_hash(rows[0]["password_hash"],password):
                raise DomainError("invalid_credentials",401)
            user=self.principal(rows[0]["id"])
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"user_id":user["id"],"authenticated":True},"provenance":{"actor":{"id":user["id"],"kind":"user"}}})
            return user
    def sign_out(self, actor):
        with self.bo.span("sign_out",provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor)) as call:
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"signed_out":True}})
            return {"signed_out":True}
    def users(self, actor):
        self.require_user(actor)
        with self.bo.span("list_colleagues",provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor)) as call:
            rows=self.store.read("SELECT id,username,display_name,role FROM users WHERE id<>? ORDER BY id",(actor["id"],))
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"count":len(rows)}})
            return rows
    def get_file(self, file_id, connection=None):
        rows=[dict(row) for row in connection.execute("SELECT * FROM files WHERE id=?",(file_id,))] if connection else self.store.read("SELECT * FROM files WHERE id=?",(file_id,))
        if not rows:
            raise DomainError("file_not_found",404)
        return rows[0]
    def allowed(self, operation, actor, file=None, connection=None):
        active=False
        if actor and file:
            sql="SELECT 1 FROM shares WHERE file_id=? AND recipient_id=? AND state='active_share'"
            args=(file["id"],actor["id"])
            active=bool(connection.execute(sql,args).fetchone()) if connection else bool(self.store.read(sql,args))
        inputs={"authenticated":actor is not None,"actor_is_admin":actor is not None and actor["role"]=="admin",
            "actor_is_uploader":actor is not None and file is not None and file["owner_id"]==actor["id"],
            "file_approved":file is not None and file["state"]=="approved","active_recipient":active}
        return self.workflow.permission(operation,inputs,bo=self.bo)
    def check(self, operation, actor, file=None, connection=None):
        self.require_user(actor)
        if not self.allowed(operation,actor,file,connection):
            raise DomainError(operation+"_not_allowed")
    def metadata(self, file):
        return self.bo.transform("db_metadata",self._metadata,file,before=lambda value:{"size":value["size"],"state":value["state"]},after=lambda value:{"size":value["size"],"state":value["state"]})
    def _metadata(self, file):
        return {key:file[key] for key in ("id","owner_id","filename","size","state","review_decision","rejection_reason","reviewer_id","workflow_id","revision","created_at")}
    def upload_file(self, actor, filename, content):
        self.require_user(actor)
        filename=PurePath(filename.replace("\\","/")).name.strip()
        if not filename or len(filename)>200 or len(content)>10*1024*1024:
            raise DomainError("invalid_file",400)
        with self.bo.span("upload_file",lambda:{"inputs":{"filename":filename,"size":len(content)}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor)) as call:
            self.check("upload",actor)
            identity="file-"+uuid.uuid4().hex
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                connection.execute("INSERT INTO files(id,owner_id,filename,size,content,state,workflow_id,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                    (identity,actor["id"],filename,len(content),content,"pending_review","workflow-"+uuid.uuid4().hex,time.time()))
            file=self.get_file(identity)
            result=lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":identity,"state":file["state"]},"provenance":self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"File","id":identity,"role":"output"}])}
            call.record("commit",result)
            call.result(result)
            self.bo.state(file)
            return self.metadata(file)
    def list_files(self, actor):
        self.require_user(actor)
        with self.bo.span("list_files",provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor)) as call:
            visible=[]
            for file in self.store.read("SELECT * FROM files ORDER BY created_at DESC"):
                if self.allowed("view",actor,file):
                    item=self.metadata(file)
                    item["shares"]=[s for s in self.store.read("SELECT id,recipient_id,state FROM shares WHERE file_id=?",(file["id"],)) if actor["id"]==file["owner_id"] or actor["role"]=="admin" or s["recipient_id"]==actor["id"]]
                    item["can_share"]=actor["id"]==file["owner_id"] and file["state"]=="approved"
                    item["can_review"]=actor["role"]=="admin" and actor["id"]!=file["owner_id"] and file["state"]=="pending_review"
                    visible.append(item)
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"count":len(visible)}})
            return visible
    def view_file(self, actor, file_id):
        self.require_user(actor)
        file=self.get_file(file_id)
        with self.bo.span("view_file",lambda:{"inputs":{"file_id":file_id}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file)) as call:
            self.check("view",actor,file)
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":file_id,"state":file["state"],"size":file["size"]}})
            return self.metadata(file)
    def download_file(self, actor, file_id):
        self.require_user(actor)
        file=self.get_file(file_id)
        with self.bo.span("download_file",lambda:{"inputs":{"file_id":file_id}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file)) as call:
            self.check("download",actor,file)
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":file_id,"size":file["size"]}})
            return file["filename"],file["content"]
    def enqueue(self, connection, kind, file, share_id, recipient_id):
        job_id="job-"+uuid.uuid4().hex
        connection.execute("INSERT INTO jobs(id,kind,file_id,share_id,recipient_id,workflow_id,available_at,bo_carrier) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (job_id,kind,file["id"],share_id,recipient_id,file["workflow_id"],time.time()+self.delay,self.bo.bo_queue_metadata()))
        return job_id
    def review_file(self, actor, file_id, decision, reason):
        self.require_user(actor)
        file=self.get_file(file_id)
        with self.bo.span("review_file",lambda:{"inputs":{"file_id":file_id,"decision":decision,"reason":reason}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file)) as call:
            if decision not in ("approved","rejected") or (decision=="rejected" and not reason.strip()) or len(reason)>1000:
                raise DomainError("invalid_review",400)
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                file=self.get_file(file_id,connection)
                self.check("review",actor,file,connection)
                if file["state"]!="pending_review":
                    raise DomainError("review_already_decided",409)
                state=self.workflow.transition(connection,file_id,file["state"],"review",file["revision"]+1,time.time())
                connection.execute("UPDATE files SET state=?,review_decision=?,rejection_reason=?,reviewer_id=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=?",
                    (state,decision,reason.strip() if decision=="rejected" else "",actor["id"],file_id))
                job_id=self.enqueue(connection,"review",file,None,file["owner_id"])
            file=self.get_file(file_id)
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":file_id,"job_id":job_id,"state":file["state"],"decision":decision},
                "provenance":self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"Job","id":job_id,"role":"output"}])})
            self.bo.state(file)
            return self.metadata(file)
    def share_file(self, actor, file_id, recipient_id):
        self.require_user(actor)
        file=self.get_file(file_id)
        with self.bo.span("share_file",lambda:{"inputs":{"file_id":file_id,"recipient_id":recipient_id}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"User","id":recipient_id,"role":"recipient"}])) as call:
            if recipient_id==actor["id"] or self.principal(recipient_id) is None:
                raise DomainError("invalid_recipient",400)
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                file=self.get_file(file_id,connection)
                self.check("share",actor,file,connection)
                if connection.execute("SELECT 1 FROM shares WHERE file_id=? AND recipient_id=?",(file_id,recipient_id)).fetchone():
                    raise DomainError("share_already_exists",409)
                share_id="share-"+uuid.uuid4().hex
                state=self.workflow.transition(connection,share_id,"approved","share",1,time.time())
                connection.execute("INSERT INTO shares(id,file_id,recipient_id,sender_id,state,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                    (share_id,file_id,recipient_id,actor["id"],state,time.time()))
                job_id=self.enqueue(connection,"share",file,share_id,recipient_id)
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":file_id,"share_id":share_id,"job_id":job_id,"state":state},
                "provenance":self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"Share","id":share_id,"role":"output"},{"type":"Job","id":job_id,"role":"output"},{"type":"User","id":recipient_id,"role":"recipient"}])})
            self.bo.state({"id":share_id,"state":state,"revision":1})
            return {"id":share_id,"state":state,"recipient_id":recipient_id}
    def revoke_share(self, actor, file_id, recipient_id):
        self.require_user(actor)
        file=self.get_file(file_id)
        with self.bo.span("revoke_share",lambda:{"inputs":{"file_id":file_id,"recipient_id":recipient_id}},
                          provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"User","id":recipient_id,"role":"recipient"}])) as call:
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                file=self.get_file(file_id,connection)
                self.check("revoke",actor,file,connection)
                row=connection.execute("SELECT * FROM shares WHERE file_id=? AND recipient_id=?",(file_id,recipient_id)).fetchone()
                if row is None:
                    raise DomainError("share_not_found",404)
                share=dict(row)
                changed=share["state"]!="revoked_share"
                cancelled=0
                if changed:
                    state=self.workflow.transition(connection,share["id"],share["state"],"revoke",share["revision"]+1,time.time())
                    connection.execute("UPDATE shares SET state=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=?",(state,share["id"]))
                    cancelled=connection.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state='cancelled' WHERE share_id=? AND kind='share' AND state='waiting'",(share["id"],)).rowcount
                    job_id=self.enqueue(connection,"revoke",file,share["id"],recipient_id)
                else:
                    job_id=connection.execute("SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE share_id=? AND kind='revoke'",(share["id"],)).fetchone()["id"]
            result={"file_id":file_id,"share_id":share["id"],"recipient_id":recipient_id,"state":"revoked_share","job_id":job_id,"revoked":changed,"cancelled_jobs":cancelled}
            completed=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"Share","id":share["id"],"role":"output"},{"type":"Job","id":job_id,"role":"output"},{"type":"User","id":recipient_id,"role":"recipient"}])
            if changed:
                call.record("commit",lambda:{"outputs":result,"provenance":completed})
                self.bo.state({"id":share["id"],"state":"revoked_share","revision":share["revision"]+1})
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":result,"provenance":completed})
            return result
    def list_messages(self, actor):
        self.require_user(actor)
        with self.bo.span("message_list",provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor)) as call:
            rows=self.store.read("SELECT id,file_id,kind,text,created_at FROM messages WHERE recipient_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC",(actor["id"],))
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"count":len(rows)}})
            return rows
    def read_message(self, actor, message_id):
        self.require_user(actor)
        with self.bo.span("read_message",lambda:{"inputs":{"message_id":message_id}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor)) as call:
            rows=self.store.read("SELECT id,file_id,kind,text,created_at FROM messages WHERE id=? AND recipient_id=?",(message_id,actor["id"]))
            if not rows:
                raise DomainError("message_not_found",404)

                            raise RuntimeError("injected_delivery_failure")

                            entity_id=file["id"]

                            connection.execute("UPDATE files SET state=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=?",(state,entity_id))
                        elif job["kind"]=="share":
                            entity_id=share["id"]

                            connection.execute("UPDATE shares SET state=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=?",(state,entity_id))
                        else:

                    call.record("commit",lambda:{"outputs":result,"provenance":completed})
                    call.result(lambda:{"outputs":result,"provenance":completed})
                    table="files" if job["kind"]=="review" else "shares"
                    if job["kind"]!="revoke":
                        self.bo.state({"id":entity_id,"state":state,"revision":self.store.read("SELECT revision FROM "+table+" WHERE id=?",(entity_id,))[0]["revision"]})
                    return True
                except Exception as error:
                    with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                        connection.execute("UPDATE jobs SET attempts=attempts+1,last_error=?,available_at=? WHERE id=? AND state='waiting'",(type(error).__name__,time.time()+self.delay,job_id))

        count=0
        for job in self.store.read("SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE state='waiting' AND available_at<=? ORDER BY available_at LIMIT 20",(time.time(),),observe=False):

def migrate_revocation(self, connection):
        rows=connection.execute("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='shares'").fetchall()
        if not rows or "'revoked_share'" in rows[0]["sql"]:
            return
        # Rebuild only the affected constraints, preserving all rows and references.
        connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF")
        try:
            connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            for table in ("shares","jobs"):
                ddl=next(statement.strip() for statement in SCHEMA.split(";") if statement.strip().startswith("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "+table+"("))
                connection.execute(ddl.replace("IF NOT EXISTS "+table,table+"_upgrade",1))
                connection.execute("INSERT INTO "+table+"_upgrade SELECT * FROM "+table)
            connection.execute("DROP TABLE jobs")
            connection.execute("DROP TABLE shares")
            connection.execute("ALTER TABLE shares_upgrade RENAME TO shares")
            connection.execute("ALTER TABLE jobs_upgrade RENAME TO jobs")
            if connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall():
                raise RuntimeError("revocation_migration_foreign_key_failure")
            connection.execute("PRAGMA user_version=3")
            connection.commit()
        except BaseException:
            connection.rollback()
            raise
        finally:
            connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--app-port",type=int,default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--graph-port",type=int,default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--no-observer",action="store_true")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    runtime=root/"runtime"
    runtime.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    key_path=runtime/"session.key"
    if not key_path.exists():
        key_path.write_text(secrets.token_hex(32),encoding="utf-8")
    store=Store(runtime/"team-files.sqlite3")
    store.initialize()
    os.environ.setdefault("TEAM_FILES_DB_URL","sqlite:///runtime/team-files.sqlite3")
    service=TeamFiles(store,Workflow(root))
    app=create_app(root,service,key_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    server=make_server("127.0.0.1",args.app_port,app,threaded=True)
    app_url="http://127.0.0.1:"+str(server.server_port)
    observer=None
    graph_url=""
    if not args.no_observer:
        try:
            from integrations.bo_integration import BOIntegration
            observer=BOIntegration(root,store)
            service.bo=observer
            observer.attach_flask(app)
            graph_url=observer.serve(args.graph_port,app_url)
        except Exception as error:
            print("Observer unavailable: "+type(error).__name__+": "+str(error),flush=True)
    app.config["GRAPH_URL"]=graph_url
    stopping=threading.Event()
    def worker():
        while not stopping.wait(0.5):
            stop_path=runtime/"stop.json"
            if stop_path.exists():
                try:
                    if json.loads(stop_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")).get("pid")==os.getpid():
                        stop(0,None)
                        return
                except (OSError,ValueError):
                    pass
            service.deliver_due()
    def stop(signum,frame):
        stopping.set()
        threading.Thread(target=server.shutdown,daemon=True).start()
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,stop)
    thread=threading.Thread(target=worker,daemon=True,name="notification-worker")
    thread.start()
    info={"pid":os.getpid(),"app_url":app_url,"graph_url":graph_url,"project_id":"team-files-otel-dialogue-20261101-03","observer_enabled":observer is not None,"delay_seconds":5}
    (runtime/"launcher.json").write_text(json.dumps(info,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(info),flush=True)
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    finally:
        stopping.set()
        thread.join(5)
        server.server_close()
        if observer:
            observer.close()

def attach_flask(self, app):
        # The observer runs on its own HTTPServer listener; it has no Flask routes here.
        static_prefixes=[rule.rule.partition("<")[0] for rule in app.url_map.iter_rules()
                         if app.has_static_folder and rule.endpoint=="static"]
        self.bo_http_exclusions=tuple(static_prefixes)
        FlaskInstrumentor().instrument_app(app,tracer_provider=self.provider,
            excluded_urls=",".join(r"^https?://[^/]+"+re.escape(prefix) for prefix in static_prefixes))

def transform(self, node, function, value, **options):
        return self.data.transform(node,function,value,**options)

def serve(self, port, app_url):
        self.server=make_server(self.session,port=port,origins=(app_url,),assets=self.root/"static/graph")
        self.thread=threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever,daemon=True,name="vibelens-http")
        self.thread.start()
        return "http://127.0.0.1:"+str(self.server.server_port)+"/graph"

def close(self):
        self.data.close()
        self.probe.flush(5)
        self.probe.close()
        if hasattr(self,"server"):
            self.server.shutdown()
            self.server.server_close()
        self.session.close()
        self.provider.shutdown()

"""File review and recipient access activate only with committed notifications."""
import time
import uuid
from pathlib import PurePath
from werkzeug.security import check_password_hash
from app.ports import ObservationPort

class DomainError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, code, status=403):
        super().__init__(code)
        self.code,self.status=code,status

class TeamFiles:
    def __init__(self, store, workflow, bo=None, delay=5.0):
        self.store,self.workflow=store,workflow
        self.bo,self.delay=bo or ObservationPort(),delay
    def principal(self, user_id):
        rows=self.store.read("SELECT id,username,display_name,role FROM users WHERE id=?",(user_id,)) if user_id else []
        return rows[0] if rows else None
    def require_user(self, actor):
        if actor is None:
            raise DomainError("authentication_required",401)
        return actor
    def sign_in(self, username, password):
        with self.bo.span("sign_in",lambda:{"inputs":{"username":username,"credential_supplied":bool(password)}},provenance=self.bo.bo_authentication_provenance()) as call:
            rows=self.store.read("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username=?",(username,))
            if not rows or not check_password_hash(rows[0]["password_hash"],password):
                raise DomainError("invalid_credentials",401)
            user=self.principal(rows[0]["id"])
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"user_id":user["id"],"authenticated":True},"provenance":{"actor":{"id":user["id"],"kind":"user"}}})
            return user
    def sign_out(self, actor):
        with self.bo.span("sign_out",provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor)) as call:
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"signed_out":True}})
            return {"signed_out":True}
    def users(self, actor):
        self.require_user(actor)
        with self.bo.span("list_colleagues",provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor)) as call:
            rows=self.store.read("SELECT id,username,display_name,role FROM users WHERE id<>? ORDER BY id",(actor["id"],))
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"count":len(rows)}})
            return rows
    def get_file(self, file_id, connection=None):
        rows=[dict(row) for row in connection.execute("SELECT * FROM files WHERE id=?",(file_id,))] if connection else self.store.read("SELECT * FROM files WHERE id=?",(file_id,))
        if not rows:
            raise DomainError("file_not_found",404)
        return rows[0]
    def allowed(self, operation, actor, file=None, connection=None):
        active=False
        if actor and file:
            sql="SELECT 1 FROM shares WHERE file_id=? AND recipient_id=? AND state='active_share'"
            args=(file["id"],actor["id"])
            active=bool(connection.execute(sql,args).fetchone()) if connection else bool(self.store.read(sql,args))
        inputs={"authenticated":actor is not None,"actor_is_admin":actor is not None and actor["role"]=="admin",
            "actor_is_uploader":actor is not None and file is not None and file["owner_id"]==actor["id"],
            "file_approved":file is not None and file["state"]=="approved","active_recipient":active}
        return self.workflow.permission(operation,inputs,bo=self.bo)
    def check(self, operation, actor, file=None, connection=None):
        self.require_user(actor)
        if not self.allowed(operation,actor,file,connection):
            raise DomainError(operation+"_not_allowed")
    def metadata(self, file):
        return self.bo.transform("db_metadata",self._metadata,file,before=lambda value:{"size":value["size"],"state":value["state"]},after=lambda value:{"size":value["size"],"state":value["state"]})
    def _metadata(self, file):
        return {key:file[key] for key in ("id","owner_id","filename","size","state","review_decision","rejection_reason","reviewer_id","workflow_id","revision","created_at")}
    def upload_file(self, actor, filename, content):
        self.require_user(actor)
        filename=PurePath(filename.replace("\\","/")).name.strip()
        if not filename or len(filename)>200 or len(content)>10*1024*1024:
            raise DomainError("invalid_file",400)
        with self.bo.span("upload_file",lambda:{"inputs":{"filename":filename,"size":len(content)}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor)) as call:
            self.check("upload",actor)
            identity="file-"+uuid.uuid4().hex
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                connection.execute("INSERT INTO files(id,owner_id,filename,size,content,state,workflow_id,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                    (identity,actor["id"],filename,len(content),content,"pending_review","workflow-"+uuid.uuid4().hex,time.time()))
            file=self.get_file(identity)
            result=lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":identity,"state":file["state"]},"provenance":self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"File","id":identity,"role":"output"}])}
            call.record("commit",result)
            call.result(result)
            self.bo.state(file)
            return self.metadata(file)
    def list_files(self, actor):
        self.require_user(actor)
        with self.bo.span("list_files",provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor)) as call:
            visible=[]
            for file in self.store.read("SELECT * FROM files ORDER BY created_at DESC"):
                if self.allowed("view",actor,file):
                    item=self.metadata(file)
                    item["shares"]=[s for s in self.store.read("SELECT id,recipient_id,state FROM shares WHERE file_id=?",(file["id"],)) if actor["id"]==file["owner_id"] or actor["role"]=="admin" or s["recipient_id"]==actor["id"]]
                    item["can_share"]=actor["id"]==file["owner_id"] and file["state"]=="approved"
                    item["can_review"]=actor["role"]=="admin" and actor["id"]!=file["owner_id"] and file["state"]=="pending_review"
                    visible.append(item)
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"count":len(visible)}})
            return visible
    def view_file(self, actor, file_id):
        self.require_user(actor)
        file=self.get_file(file_id)
        with self.bo.span("view_file",lambda:{"inputs":{"file_id":file_id}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file)) as call:
            self.check("view",actor,file)
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":file_id,"state":file["state"],"size":file["size"]}})
            return self.metadata(file)
    def download_file(self, actor, file_id):
        self.require_user(actor)
        file=self.get_file(file_id)
        with self.bo.span("download_file",lambda:{"inputs":{"file_id":file_id}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file)) as call:
            self.check("download",actor,file)
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":file_id,"size":file["size"]}})
            return file["filename"],file["content"]
    def enqueue(self, connection, kind, file, share_id, recipient_id):
        job_id="job-"+uuid.uuid4().hex
        connection.execute("INSERT INTO jobs(id,kind,file_id,share_id,recipient_id,workflow_id,available_at,bo_carrier) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (job_id,kind,file["id"],share_id,recipient_id,file["workflow_id"],time.time()+self.delay,self.bo.bo_queue_metadata()))
        return job_id
    def review_file(self, actor, file_id, decision, reason):
        self.require_user(actor)
        file=self.get_file(file_id)
        with self.bo.span("review_file",lambda:{"inputs":{"file_id":file_id,"decision":decision,"reason":reason}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file)) as call:
            if decision not in ("approved","rejected") or (decision=="rejected" and not reason.strip()) or len(reason)>1000:
                raise DomainError("invalid_review",400)
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                file=self.get_file(file_id,connection)
                self.check("review",actor,file,connection)
                if file["state"]!="pending_review":
                    raise DomainError("review_already_decided",409)
                state=self.workflow.transition(connection,file_id,file["state"],"review",file["revision"]+1,time.time())
                connection.execute("UPDATE files SET state=?,review_decision=?,rejection_reason=?,reviewer_id=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=?",
                    (state,decision,reason.strip() if decision=="rejected" else "",actor["id"],file_id))
                job_id=self.enqueue(connection,"review",file,None,file["owner_id"])
            file=self.get_file(file_id)
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":file_id,"job_id":job_id,"state":file["state"],"decision":decision},
                "provenance":self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"Job","id":job_id,"role":"output"}])})
            self.bo.state(file)
            return self.metadata(file)
    def share_file(self, actor, file_id, recipient_id):
        self.require_user(actor)
        file=self.get_file(file_id)
        with self.bo.span("share_file",lambda:{"inputs":{"file_id":file_id,"recipient_id":recipient_id}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"User","id":recipient_id,"role":"recipient"}])) as call:
            if recipient_id==actor["id"] or self.principal(recipient_id) is None:
                raise DomainError("invalid_recipient",400)
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                file=self.get_file(file_id,connection)
                self.check("share",actor,file,connection)
                if connection.execute("SELECT 1 FROM shares WHERE file_id=? AND recipient_id=?",(file_id,recipient_id)).fetchone():
                    raise DomainError("share_already_exists",409)
                share_id="share-"+uuid.uuid4().hex
                state=self.workflow.transition(connection,share_id,"approved","share",1,time.time())
                connection.execute("INSERT INTO shares(id,file_id,recipient_id,sender_id,state,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                    (share_id,file_id,recipient_id,actor["id"],state,time.time()))
                job_id=self.enqueue(connection,"share",file,share_id,recipient_id)
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":file_id,"share_id":share_id,"job_id":job_id,"state":state},
                "provenance":self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"Share","id":share_id,"role":"output"},{"type":"Job","id":job_id,"role":"output"},{"type":"User","id":recipient_id,"role":"recipient"}])})
            self.bo.state({"id":share_id,"state":state,"revision":1})
            return {"id":share_id,"state":state,"recipient_id":recipient_id}
    def revoke_share(self, actor, file_id, recipient_id):
        self.require_user(actor)
        file=self.get_file(file_id)
        with self.bo.span("revoke_share",lambda:{"inputs":{"file_id":file_id,"recipient_id":recipient_id}},
                          provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"User","id":recipient_id,"role":"recipient"}])) as call:
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                file=self.get_file(file_id,connection)
                self.check("revoke",actor,file,connection)
                row=connection.execute("SELECT * FROM shares WHERE file_id=? AND recipient_id=?",(file_id,recipient_id)).fetchone()
                if row is None:
                    raise DomainError("share_not_found",404)
                share=dict(row)
                changed=share["state"]!="revoked_share"
                cancelled=0
                if changed:
                    state=self.workflow.transition(connection,share["id"],share["state"],"revoke",share["revision"]+1,time.time())
                    connection.execute("UPDATE shares SET state=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=?",(state,share["id"]))
                    cancelled=connection.execute("UPDATE jobs SET state='cancelled' WHERE share_id=? AND kind='share' AND state='waiting'",(share["id"],)).rowcount
                    job_id=self.enqueue(connection,"revoke",file,share["id"],recipient_id)
                else:
                    job_id=connection.execute("SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE share_id=? AND kind='revoke'",(share["id"],)).fetchone()["id"]
            result={"file_id":file_id,"share_id":share["id"],"recipient_id":recipient_id,"state":"revoked_share","job_id":job_id,"revoked":changed,"cancelled_jobs":cancelled}
            completed=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor,file,[{"type":"Share","id":share["id"],"role":"output"},{"type":"Job","id":job_id,"role":"output"},{"type":"User","id":recipient_id,"role":"recipient"}])
            if changed:
                call.record("commit",lambda:{"outputs":result,"provenance":completed})
                self.bo.state({"id":share["id"],"state":"revoked_share","revision":share["revision"]+1})
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":result,"provenance":completed})
            return result
    def list_messages(self, actor):
        self.require_user(actor)
        with self.bo.span("message_list",provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor)) as call:
            rows=self.store.read("SELECT id,file_id,kind,text,created_at FROM messages WHERE recipient_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC",(actor["id"],))
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"count":len(rows)}})
            return rows
    def read_message(self, actor, message_id):
        self.require_user(actor)
        with self.bo.span("read_message",lambda:{"inputs":{"message_id":message_id}},provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor)) as call:
            rows=self.store.read("SELECT id,file_id,kind,text,created_at FROM messages WHERE id=? AND recipient_id=?",(message_id,actor["id"]))
            if not rows:
                raise DomainError("message_not_found",404)
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"message_id":message_id}})
            return rows[0]
    def list_reviews(self, actor):
        self.require_user(actor)
        with self.bo.span("list_reviews",provenance=self.bo.bo_provenance(actor)) as call:
            if actor["role"]!="admin":
                raise DomainError("administrator_required")
            rows=[self.metadata(file) for file in self.store.read("SELECT * FROM files WHERE state='pending_review' AND owner_id<>? ORDER BY created_at",(actor["id"],))]
            call.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"count":len(rows)}})
            return rows
    def deliver_notification(self, job_id, fail_after_message=False):

"""Native declaration-driven states and shared rule evaluation."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from .bo_runtime import BOExecutor
from .policy.runtime import evaluate
from app.policy import flag_enabled

class Workflow:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root=Path(root)
        project=json.loads((self.root/"bo_stategraph/project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.machine=project["model"]["machine"]
        self.policy=project["model"]["policy"]
        self.executor=BOExecutor(self.machine)
    def transition(self, connection, entity_id, current, event, revision, now):
        result=self.executor.step(current,event,{},{})
        connection.execute("INSERT INTO transitions(entity_id,event,before_state,after_state,revision,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (entity_id,event,current,result["state"],revision,now))
        return result["state"]
    def permission(self, operation, inputs, bo=None):
        result=evaluate(self.policy,operation,inputs,{"flag_enabled":flag_enabled},source_root=self.root,fact_revision="request-local")
        if bo:
            bo.policy(result)
        return result["value"] is True

"""Launch this project's application, worker and optional VibeLens service together."""
import argparse
import json
import os
import secrets
import signal
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from werkzeug.serving import make_server
from app.storage import Store
from app.domain import TeamFiles
from app.web import create_app
from bo_stategraph.workflow import Workflow

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--app-port",type=int,default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--graph-port",type=int,default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--no-observer",action="store_true")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    runtime=root/"runtime"
    runtime.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    key_path=runtime/"session.key"
    if not key_path.exists():
        key_path.write_text(secrets.token_hex(32),encoding="utf-8")
    store=Store(runtime/"team-files.sqlite3")
    store.initialize()
    os.environ.setdefault("TEAM_FILES_DB_URL","sqlite:///runtime/team-files.sqlite3")
    service=TeamFiles(store,Workflow(root))
    app=create_app(root,service,key_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    server=make_server("127.0.0.1",args.app_port,app,threaded=True)
    app_url="http://127.0.0.1:"+str(server.server_port)
    observer=None
    graph_url=""
    if not args.no_observer:
        try:
            from integrations.bo_integration import BOIntegration
            observer=BOIntegration(root,store)
            service.bo=observer
            observer.attach_flask(app)
            graph_url=observer.serve(args.graph_port,app_url)
        except Exception as error:
            print("Observer unavailable: "+type(error).__name__+": "+str(error),flush=True)
    app.config["GRAPH_URL"]=graph_url
    stopping=threading.Event()
    def worker():
        while not stopping.wait(0.5):
            stop_path=runtime/"stop.json"
            if stop_path.exists():
                try:
                    if json.loads(stop_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")).get("pid")==os.getpid():
                        stop(0,None)
                        return
                except (OSError,ValueError):
                    pass
            service.deliver_due()
    def stop(signum,frame):
        stopping.set()
        threading.Thread(target=server.shutdown,daemon=True).start()
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,stop)
    thread=threading.Thread(target=worker,daemon=True,name="notification-worker")
    thread.start()
    info={"pid":os.getpid(),"app_url":app_url,"graph_url":graph_url,"project_id":"team-files-otel-dialogue-20261101-03","observer_enabled":observer is not None,"delay_seconds":5}
    (runtime/"launcher.json").write_text(json.dumps(info,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(info),flush=True)
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    finally:
        stopping.set()
        thread.join(5)
        server.server_close()
        if observer:
            observer.close()

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()

"""Native UI route and WSGI response readers; no values are read from BO events."""
import io
from opentelemetry import trace
from flask import request

HTTP_CASES = ("frontend_commands", "frontend_denials", "frontend_errors")
ROUTES = {
    ("GET", "/"): "api_workspace",
    ("POST", "/command/<operation>"): "api_command",
    ("GET", "/file/<file_id>"): "api_file_info",
    ("GET", "/api/<path:operation>"): "api_get",
    ("POST", "/api/<path:operation>"): "api_post",
}


class NativeHTTPAudit:
    def __init__(self, app):
        self.rows = []
        self.native_http = {}
        self.routes = [{"path": rule.rule, "method": method, "endpoint": rule.endpoint,
                        "symbol": app.view_functions[rule.endpoint].__qualname__.replace(".<locals>.", ".")}
                       for rule in app.url_map.iter_rules() if rule.endpoint != "static"
                       for method in sorted(rule.methods - {"HEAD", "OPTIONS"})]

        @app.after_request
        def read_native_response(response):
            context = trace.get_current_span().get_span_context()
            row = {"route": request.url_rule.rule if request.url_rule else None,
                   "method": request.method, "path": request.path,
                   "inputs": {"path": request.path, **{
                       key: value for key, value in (request.view_args or {}).items()
                       if key in {"operation", "file_id"} and not request.path.startswith("/api/")}},
                   "trace_id": format(context.trace_id, "032x"),
                   "span_id": format(context.span_id, "016x")}
            request.environ["trial.native_http"] = row
            return response

        original = app.wsgi_app

        def read_wsgi(environ, start_response):
            def native_start(status, headers, exc_info=None):
                row = environ.get("trial.native_http", {"path": environ["PATH_INFO"]})
                row["status"] = int(status.split()[0])
                row["location"] = dict(headers).get("Location")
                self.rows.append(row)
                node = ROUTES.get((row.get("method"), row.get("route")))
                if node:
                    self.native_http.setdefault(node, []).append(row)
                return start_response(status, headers, exc_info)
            return original(environ, native_start)
        app.wsgi_app = read_wsgi


def frontend_scenario(case, trial):
    t = trial
    audit = NativeHTTPAudit(t.app)
    t.http_audit = audit
    statuses = []

    def expect(response, status):
        statuses.append(response.status_code)
        assert response.status_code == status, (case, response.status_code, status)
        if status == 303:
            assert response.headers["Location"] == "/"
        return response

    def form(username, operation, **data):
        client = t.client(username)
        return client.post("/command/"+operation,
                           data={"csrf": t.clients[username][1], **data})

    if case == "frontend_commands":
        anonymous = t.app.test_client()
        expect(anonymous.get("/"), 200)
        expect(anonymous.post("/command/login", data={"username": "member1", "password": "Trial2026!"}), 303)
        # Use the same native session established by the actual HTML login form.
        with anonymous.session_transaction() as native_session:
            csrf = native_session["csrf"]
        t.clients["member1"] = (anonymous, csrf)
        expect(form("member1", "upload", file=(io.BytesIO(b"Native form bytes\n"), "form.txt")), 303)
        identity = t.read("SELECT id FROM files")[0]["id"]
        expect(anonymous.get("/"), 200)
        expect(anonymous.get("/file/"+identity), 200)
        expect(t.client("admin1").get("/"), 200)
        expect(form("admin1", "review", file_id=identity, decision="approved"), 303)
        assert t.state(identity) == "review_notice_wait"
        expect(form("member1", "share", file_id=identity, recipient_id="member-2"), 303)
        assert not t.read("SELECT id FROM shares")
        t.service.deliver_notification(t.job(identity, "review")["id"])
        expect(form("member1", "share", file_id=identity, recipient_id="member-2"), 303)
        assert t.state(identity) == "approved"
        recipient = t.client("member2")
        expect(recipient.get("/file/"+identity), 403)
        expect(recipient.get("/api/files/"+identity+"/download"), 403)
        t.service.deliver_notification(t.job(identity, "share")["id"])
        expect(recipient.get("/"), 200)
        expect(recipient.get("/file/"+identity), 200)
        downloaded = expect(recipient.get("/api/files/"+identity+"/download"), 200)
        assert downloaded.data == b"Native form bytes\n"
        expect(form("member2", "share", file_id=identity, recipient_id="admin-2"), 303)
        assert len(t.read("SELECT id FROM shares")) == 1
        expect(form("member1", "logout"), 303)
        expect(anonymous.get("/file/"+identity), 401)
        assert len(t.read("SELECT id FROM messages")) == 2
    elif case == "frontend_denials":
        identity = t.upload("admin1")
        owner = t.client("admin1")
        expect(form("admin1", "review", file_id=identity, decision="approved"), 303)
        assert t.state(identity) == "pending_review"
        expect(form("admin2", "review", file_id=identity, decision="rejected", reason="Retain the original"), 303)
        t.service.deliver_notification(t.job(identity, "review")["id"])
        assert t.state(identity) == "rejected"
        expect(owner.get("/file/"+identity), 200)
        assert expect(owner.get("/api/files/"+identity+"/download"), 200).data == b"Synthetic team file\n"
        expect(form("admin1", "share", file_id=identity, recipient_id="member-1"), 303)
        assert not t.read("SELECT id FROM shares")
        expect(t.client("member2").get("/file/"+identity), 403)
        expect(owner.get("/file/missing"), 404)
        expect(owner.get("/api/files/missing/download"), 404)
        expect(owner.post("/command/review", data={"file_id": identity}), 403)
        expect(owner.post("/command/share", data={"csrf": t.clients["admin1"][1]}, headers={"Origin": "http://foreign.invalid"}), 403)
        expect(owner.post("/command/login", data={"username": "admin1", "password": "incorrect"}), 303)
        expect(owner.get("/file/"+identity), 401)
        expect(owner.get("/api/files/"+identity+"/download"), 401)
        expect(owner.post("/command/upload", data={"csrf": "invalid"}), 403)
    elif case == "frontend_errors":
        identity = t.upload()
        client = t.client("member1")
        t.app.config["TESTING"] = False

        def fail(*args, **kwargs):
            raise RuntimeError("synthetic_native_http_failure")

        for name, method, path, data in [
            ("list_files", "GET", "/", None),
            ("upload_file", "POST", "/command/upload", {"csrf": t.clients["member1"][1], "file": (io.BytesIO(b"error"), "error.txt")}),
            ("review_file", "POST", "/command/review", {"csrf": t.clients["member1"][1], "file_id": identity, "decision": "approved"}),
            ("share_file", "POST", "/command/share", {"csrf": t.clients["member1"][1], "file_id": identity, "recipient_id": "member-2"}),
            ("view_file", "GET", "/file/"+identity, None),
            ("download_file", "GET", "/api/files/"+identity+"/download", None)]:
            original = getattr(t.service, name)
            setattr(t.service, name, fail)
            try:
                expect(client.open(path, method=method, data=data), 500)
            finally:
                setattr(t.service, name, original)
    else:
        raise ValueError(case)
    return {"native_http_statuses": statuses, "native_http_checks": len(statuses), "frontend_business_passed": True}


def check_http_run(run):
    """Recompute response comparisons from raw native and observed facts."""
    events = run["events"]
    by_id = {event["id"]: event for event in events}
    api_nodes = set(ROUTES.values())
    checked = 0
    for node, rows in run["native_http"].items():
        for row in rows:
            span = (row["trace_id"], row["span_id"])
            matched = [event for event in events if event["node"] in api_nodes
                       and (event["trace"]["trace_id"], event["trace"]["span_id"]) == span]
            assert len(matched) == 2, ("HTTP boundary count", row, len(matched))
            assert {event["node"] for event in matched} == {node}
            assert {event["phase"] for event in matched} == {"enter", "return"}
            returned = next(event for event in matched if event["phase"] == "return")
            assert returned["outputs"]["status"] == row["status"], ("Native HTTP status mismatch", row)
            assert all(event["inputs"] == row["inputs"] for event in matched), ("Native HTTP input mismatch", row)
            if row["status"] == 500:
                assert returned["exception"]["type"] == "RuntimeError"
            for event in events:
                if event["node"] in api_nodes or event.get("phase") != "enter":
                    continue
                metadata = event.get("trace", {})
                if (metadata.get("trace_id"), metadata.get("parent_span_id")) == span:
                    parent = by_id[event["parent_event_id"]]
                    assert parent["node"] == node and parent["phase"] == "enter"
                    assert parent["trace"]["span_id"] == row["span_id"]
            checked += 1
    assert sum(event["phase"] == "return" and event["node"] in api_nodes for event in events) == checked
    return checked

"""Native application responses for names also used on the separate observer listener."""
from tests.http_cases import NativeHTTPAudit

APPLICATION_PATHS=("/api/events","/api/view","/api/recordings","/api/design",
                   "/api/capture","/api/source","/api/stategraph/export",
                   "/api/bo/health","/api/unknown-native-operation")


def listener_scenario(trial):
    audit=NativeHTTPAudit(trial.app)
    trial.http_audit=audit
    before=trial.read("SELECT id,state,revision FROM files")
    anonymous=trial.app.test_client()
    responses=[]
    for path in APPLICATION_PATHS:
        response=anonymous.get(path)
        assert response.status_code==404 and response.json=={"error":"route_not_found"},(path,response.status_code,response.json)
        responses.append(response.status_code)
    # Valid native authentication/CSRF reaches the same unknown-operation boundary on POST.
    client=trial.client("member1")
    for path in APPLICATION_PATHS:
        response=client.post(path,json={},headers={"X-CSRF-Token":trial.clients["member1"][1]})
        assert response.status_code==404 and response.json=={"error":"route_not_found"},(path,response.status_code,response.json)
        responses.append(response.status_code)
    after=trial.read("SELECT id,state,revision FROM files")
    assert before==after and not trial.read("SELECT id FROM jobs") and not trial.read("SELECT id FROM messages")
    return {"unknown_get_requests":len(APPLICATION_PATHS),"unknown_post_requests":len(APPLICATION_PATHS),
            "native_statuses":responses,"native_storage_unchanged":before==after,"frontend_business_passed":all(status==404 for status in responses)}

"""Independent HTTP, SQLite and worker race expectations for share revocation."""
import threading
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from tests.http_cases import NativeHTTPAudit
from app.domain import TeamFiles
from bo_stategraph.workflow import Workflow
from tests.scenarios import ROOT

REVOKE_CASES=("revoke_active","revoke_pending","revoke_race","revoke_http_error")


def revoke_scenario(case,t):
    t.http_audit=NativeHTTPAudit(t.app)
    identity=t.upload()
    t.approve(identity)
    assert t.share(identity).status_code==201
    share=t.read("SELECT * FROM shares WHERE file_id=?",(identity,))[0]
    original=t.job(identity,"share")
    recipient=t.client("member2")
    download="/api/files/"+identity+"/download"
    endpoint="files/"+identity+"/revoke"
    notices=lambda: t.read("SELECT * FROM messages WHERE kind='revoke' AND file_id=?",(identity,))
    state=lambda: t.read("SELECT state FROM shares WHERE id=?",(share["id"],))[0]["state"]
    if case=="revoke_active":
        t.service.deliver_notification(original["id"])
        assert recipient.get(download).status_code==200
        owner=t.client("member1")
        response=owner.post("/command/revoke",data={"csrf":t.clients["member1"][1],"file_id":identity,"recipient_id":"member-2"})
        assert response.status_code==303
        assert state()=="revoked_share"
        assert not notices()
        immediate=recipient.get(download)
        assert immediate.status_code==403
        assert recipient.get("/file/"+identity).status_code==403
        assert owner.get(download).status_code==200
        assert t.client("admin2").get(download).status_code==200
        job=t.job(identity,"revoke")
        assert t.service.deliver_notification(job["id"])
        assert recipient.get(download).status_code==403
        assert notices()[0]["recipient_id"]=="member-2"
        # Revoking an administrator's share must retain their independent admin basis.
        assert t.share(identity,recipient_id="admin-1").status_code==201
        t.service.deliver_notification(t.job(identity,"share")["id"])
        assert t.post("member1",endpoint,json={"recipient_id":"admin-1"}).status_code==200
        admin_access=t.client("admin1").get(download)
        assert admin_access.status_code==200
        assert len(t.read("SELECT id FROM shares WHERE file_id=? AND state='revoked_share'",(identity,)))==2
        other=t.upload("admin1")
        assert t.review(other,username="admin2").status_code==200
        t.service.deliver_notification(t.job(other,"review")["id"])
        for target in ("member-1","member-2"):
            assert t.share(other,username="admin1",recipient_id=target).status_code==201
            t.service.deliver_notification(t.job(other,"share")["id"])
        assert t.post("admin1","files/"+other+"/revoke",json={"recipient_id":"member-1"}).status_code==200
        removed=t.client("member1").get("/api/files/"+other+"/download")
        retained=t.client("member2").get("/api/files/"+other+"/download")
        assert removed.status_code==403 and retained.status_code==200
        out={"immediate_download_status":immediate.status_code,"admin_access":admin_access.status_code,
             "notice_recipient":notices()[0]["recipient_id"],"file_state":t.state(identity),
             "targeted_isolation":removed.status_code==403 and retained.status_code==200}
    elif case=="revoke_pending":
        assert t.post("admin1",endpoint,json={"recipient_id":"member-2"}).status_code==403
        assert t.post("member2",endpoint,json={"recipient_id":"member-2"}).status_code==403
        assert state()=="share_notice_wait"
        saved_enqueue=t.service.enqueue
        def fail_outbox(connection,kind,file,share_id,recipient_id):
            if kind=="revoke":
                raise RuntimeError("synthetic_revoke_outbox_failure")
            return saved_enqueue(connection,kind,file,share_id,recipient_id)
        t.service.enqueue=fail_outbox
        t.app.config["TESTING"]=False
        try:
            assert t.post("member1",endpoint,json={"recipient_id":"member-2"}).status_code==500
        finally:
            t.service.enqueue=saved_enqueue
            t.app.config["TESTING"]=True
        assert state()=="share_notice_wait"
        assert t.read("SELECT state FROM jobs WHERE id=?",(original["id"],))[0]["state"]=="waiting"
        assert not t.read("SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE kind='revoke'")
        response=t.post("member1",endpoint,json={"recipient_id":"member-2"})
        assert response.status_code==200
        assert response.json["share"]["cancelled_jobs"]==1
        assert state()=="revoked_share"
        assert t.read("SELECT state FROM jobs WHERE id=?",(original["id"],))[0]["state"]=="cancelled"
        stale_result=t.service.deliver_notification(original["id"])
        assert not stale_result
        job=t.job(identity,"revoke")
        try:
            t.service.deliver_notification(job["id"],fail_after_message=True)
        except RuntimeError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError("The native revocation notification rollback did not execute")
        assert not notices()
        failed_notice_download=recipient.get(download)
        assert failed_notice_download.status_code==403
        restarted=TeamFiles(t.store,Workflow(ROOT),bo=t.service.bo,delay=0)
        audit=getattr(t.service.bo,"native_audit",None)
        if audit is not None:
            audit.attach_service(restarted)
        assert restarted.deliver_notification(job["id"])
        assert not restarted.deliver_notification(job["id"])
        again=t.post("member1",endpoint,json={"recipient_id":"member-2"})
        assert again.status_code==200 and not again.json["share"]["revoked"]
        assert again.json["share"]["job_id"]==job["id"]
        assert len(notices())==1 and notices()[0]["recipient_id"]=="member-2"
        assert recipient.get(download).status_code==403
        message_id=notices()[0]["id"]
        assert recipient.get("/api/messages/"+message_id).status_code==200
        foreign_notice=t.client("member1").get("/api/messages/"+message_id)
        assert foreign_notice.status_code==404
        assert not t.read("SELECT id FROM messages WHERE job_id=?",(original["id"],))
        out={"final_state":state(),"stale_job_result":stale_result,"revoke_messages":len(notices()),
             "download_after_failed_notice":failed_notice_download.status_code,"private_notice":foreign_notice.status_code==404}
    elif case=="revoke_race":
        selected=threading.Event()
        resume=threading.Event()
        original_read=t.store.read
        def delayed_read(sql,parameters=(),observe=True):
            rows=original_read(sql,parameters,observe=observe)
            if observe and sql=="SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE id=?" and parameters==(original["id"],):
                selected.set()
                assert resume.wait(15),"The prefetched worker was not released"
            return rows
        t.store.read=delayed_read
        try:
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as executor:
                future=executor.submit(t.service.deliver_notification,original["id"])
                try:
                    assert selected.wait(15),"The real worker did not prefetch its native job"
                    response=t.post("member1",endpoint,json={"recipient_id":"member-2"})
                    assert response.status_code==200
                    assert recipient.get(download).status_code==403
                finally:
                    resume.set()
                late_result=future.result(timeout=15)
                assert late_result is False
        finally:
            t.store.read=original_read
        assert state()=="revoked_share"
        assert not t.read("SELECT id FROM messages WHERE job_id=?",(original["id"],))
        t.service.deliver_notification(t.job(identity,"revoke")["id"])
        # Opposite serialization: delivery commits first, then revoke still wins.
        assert t.share(identity,recipient_id="admin-1").status_code==201
        t.service.deliver_notification(t.job(identity,"share")["id"])
        assert t.post("member1",endpoint,json={"recipient_id":"admin-1"}).status_code==200
        assert not t.read("SELECT id FROM shares WHERE file_id=? AND state='active_share'",(identity,))
        out={"final_state":state(),"late_worker_delivered":late_result,
             "late_share_messages":len(t.read("SELECT id FROM messages WHERE job_id=?",(original["id"],))),
             "both_serializations_revoked":not bool(t.read("SELECT id FROM shares WHERE file_id=? AND state='active_share'",(identity,)))}
    elif case=="revoke_http_error":
        t.app.config["TESTING"]=False
        owner=t.client("member1")
        assert owner.post("/command/revoke",data={"file_id":identity,"recipient_id":"member-2"}).status_code==403
        def fail(*args,**kwargs):
            raise RuntimeError("synthetic_revoke_framework_failure")
        saved=t.service.revoke_share
        t.service.revoke_share=fail
        try:
            form=owner.post("/command/revoke",data={"csrf":t.clients["member1"][1],"file_id":identity,"recipient_id":"member-2"})
            api=t.post("member1",endpoint,json={"recipient_id":"member-2"})
            assert form.status_code==500 and api.status_code==500
        finally:
            t.service.revoke_share=saved
        assert state()=="share_notice_wait" and not notices()
        out={"form_status":form.status_code,"api_status":api.status_code,"native_state_unchanged":state()=="share_notice_wait"}
    else:
        raise ValueError(case)
    out["frontend_business_passed"]=True
    return out
